outcome: failed transient evoked otoacoustic emissions (TEOAE) test
failed automated Auditory Brainstem Response (aABR) test
cohort: The participants were newborns divided into two groups: those born to mothers with gestational diabetes and those born to non-diabetic mothers.
finding: Newborns of mothers with gestational diabetes have a higher possibility of presumptive hearing impairment compared to newborns of non-diabetic mothers, as evidenced by failed hearing screening tests.
